title: Bookfinder
description: A bukkit minecraft server plugin for finding enchanted books stored in chests.
body:
... finds a enchanted book stored in current chunk's chests.

### Usage

Walk close to your chest(s) and type: `/findbook <searchterm>`. Now its searching in 3 by 3 chunks around the players position in all chests for a book with the enchantments containing "searchterm" in name.

Available languages:

- English
- German
